text: 1 TELELE DA.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: O JAKPELO den ye ki pia biila lie,
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: o yendo ñden yii hamlidi o lielo haminali.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: Bi kuli den ye leni bi ba ki ta koo.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: Lawani yoginu n den kaali ke hamlidi den yede o ba ko ba pari o kuanu.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: O ba mo den yedo ke kanu na ye po.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: Lawani o den yedi o ba ke hali wani fii o na la ke nuli pedi ya tugu yeni,
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: lani ya po o mo den yedi ke o nan pia u sanu ki ba pedi ku tugu.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: O ba den guano ke na bi bani ko tie ya biiga n kan ga tundi.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: O den yedi o buali ko den sundi o yelii wan maali ya daali,
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: ko yii kan ga tundi.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: Lani ya po o den pari o kuanu.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: O den fii ki ban kili ti pedi.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: La tugu mo den tie pola kanu.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: Wan kili li poli den bualo ke ⴄmen pee.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: O den yedi min kan ga tundi,
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: n pee li poli den yedi o jawaba n ñaa todi kan ga tundi n pedi o tugu.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: O den yedi o ba ko nan pedi ki gbeni o kuanu.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: O ba den jaando ki go yedi utienu soagini o tuonli liiga.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: Kan ga tundi den fii ki ba kili o fian siali li poli go den bualo ke ñee n siagi ti pedi o den yedi ke wani kan ga tundi,
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: li poli den yiini o jawaaba ke bi go todi o.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: O den ba yedi o ba ko nan sia o fatula,
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: o ba den pugino i jandii.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: Yoginuba ku siagu ya cili o bado ya puni sanu nilo ba kuli kan buli.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: Ki cicili taga den mini a ma o bado den wani ke gi kua ba candi u dogu.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: Lawani o ba ki den pia sanu ki buli.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: Ki taa liega o bado den teni ke o bantiagu kpani ke u sanu ye ban cuagi.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: Kan ga tundi den ta o diibuoli ki ban cili ti jadi,
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: a ma poli den buali ke ŋen ya bu,
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: o den yedi mini kanga tundi.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: O den cedi ke o jawaaba den todi o.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: o den ma yedi o ba ke o buli gbeni o kuanu,
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: o ba den jandi o.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: ki taaga den mini ki gnani o jadi,
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: lani ya po ba ja yengu ki den sieni.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: Bu kpabu yogunu o den logidi a ñiana kelima wan den sia ya po u muagu na den pia palu.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: li poli go den mia o jawaaba ke bi todi o.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: o den ba yedi o ba ke o koo gbeni o ba den pugini o i jandi.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: Ti fatudi n ba u palu o den guani ki ban cili ti pedi li poli go den puguni o i buali.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: O den yedi wan kan ga tundi.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: Bi jawaaba go den ñani ki pedi o po.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: O den man todi o ba a ma o den jandi o.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: li daali den cua ke o yedi o pua n gudi o kuanu kelima o den pia sancenli.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: O pua den gedi,
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: i dii den pia mi jawaama,
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: a ma u yienu n pagi o den sua ka dii gbada yee u kuanu on fii ki cili ki pee laa dii.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: Li poli den gbadi ki buali lan tie yua o den yedi mini kan ga tundi ya pua.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: O den yedi o jawaabi ñan todi kan ga tundi pua.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: Bi den ñani ki pedi i dii kuli.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: Kanga tundi pua den cili i mue a ma li poli den teni ke o jawaaba mua ki todi o.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: kan ga tundi den gbadi ki fii pundi o kuanu ki sua ko dii kuli pedi.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: O den buali o pua lan ga ma ke o togi o.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: o pali den fii ke o cili ki pua o pua.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: Li poli den buali ke o yedi wani poua o pua.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: Li poli go den teni ke o jawaaba todi o ko poua o pua ke o kpe.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: O den kuni leni mi kuma ki ban waani o ba.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: O ba den yedo ke ne o tie yua kan ga tunde.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: Li bua waani ke yala n ti kuali wan li kuale.
title: 1 TELELE DA

text: 2 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI POANDO.
title: 2 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: Bi den ye u dogu,
title: 2 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: laa dogu ni o bado den pia o bissalo ki bua pa o o jaa.
title: 2 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: Jakpeliga den yedi ke poando na jaligi.
title: 2 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: O bado den yedi ke bi ba sani mi nuama yua n kpa pundi o deni wani die o pua.
title: 2 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: O den punba u sanu ke ban kuni ki ban bogini.
title: 2 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: O poando den kuni o deni a ma o na fidi ki guani.
title: 2 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: O den togidi o diegu ya ba o bado n ye ya la yeni jakpaliga n de yedi o yala.
title: 2 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: O diegu yaba den taa a jaaga.
title: 2 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: Bi den yeni ke bi ba tieni nufanbu,
title: 2 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: bi den bogini poanda naa ki ban sieni ban ba sani naani hali keli da faa.
title: 2 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: Yendo den sedi ban ba cili nani,
title: 2 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: bon toa suagi liigi wamu,
title: 2 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: o ne n ban sedi siigini o bon naalo n ban ya ye o bado cubulignoabu.
title: 2 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: Jakpeliga n faa ki gedi poando deni ke ban man sani.
title: 2 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: Bi den yedo ke poando ga liiga o den pundi sua ke o see ki gu o.
title: 2 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: Bi den cili mi nuama jakpeliga n sani.
title: 2 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: Ki buali poando n ye nani wan tuo liiga.
title: 2 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: Jakpeliga n pugini mi nuama ki pugini I yini poando n tuo liga.
title: 2 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: Lawani jakpeliga n piti o cacaadi ki sani hama wan nagi o bado deni wan yi ni poando wan tuo deni.
title: 2 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: O bado n ta o bi salo ki teni poando.
title: 2 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: Li bua waani ke nilo ba kuli n da faali o yuli.
title: 2 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: 3 TELELE KUNKULI LENI KANKAMNATUOLO.
title: 3 TELELE KUNKULI LENI

text: Bi den ta ki ye kan yendo mi niama den kali bi siigi ni ,
title: 3 TELELE KUNKULI LENI

text: yua kuli den toa ke wani n kpeli o lielo.
title: 3 TELELE KUNKULI LENI

text: A ma laa niama den ba o bado tubilini.
title: 3 TELELE KUNKULI LENI

text: O den yim ba bi den pundi badiegu ,
title: 3 TELELE KUNKULI LENI

text: a ma o den mia utienu n jia tii budi.
title: 3 TELELE KUNKULI LENI

text: Bi den buali yua ya bani o madi yoginu.
title: 3 TELELE KUNKULI LENI

text: Bi den yen ke bi bani.
title: 3 TELELE KUNKULI LENI

text: Bi den cili ki buali tuolo bi mala be yoginu ?
title: 3 TELELE KUNKULI LENI

text: o den yedi ke ban malo ya yoginu li den sua ke ki tinga ki den pia palu,
title: 3 TELELE KUNKULI LENI

text: li ya po teni ke n den cuoni ki lomdi.
title: 3 TELELE KUNKULI LENI

text: Ban yedi ke o kpeliga.
title: 3 TELELE KUNKULI LENI

text: Ban buali kunkuli a mo bii mala ben yoginu ?
title: 3 TELELE KUNKULI LENI

text: o den yedi ke ban malo ya yoginu li sua ke ki tinga nan da ye ke tampoli mo ko da ye.
title: 3 TELELE KUNKULI LENI

text: Li ya po teni ke utienu den tieni o po tampoli poagu leni tiipo.
title: 3 TELELE KUNKULI LENI

text: Ban gia mi mama ke kunkuli n kpeliga ki kie tuolo.
title: 3 TELELE KUNKULI LENI

text: Li bundi ka a ya didi utienu tagima a ba fiidi ki saagi a bina.
title: 3 TELELE KUNKULI LENI

text: 4 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI SAMADILI.
title: 4 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: Jakpeliga den yen leni samadili.
title: 4 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: A ma o den bua ki kpa samadili o na bani wan ba tien mama.
title: 4 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: O den yedi ke ban ya siagi bi lieba.
title: 4 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: A ma samadili n ba kpa cili.
title: 4 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: O den tuo o den liingi u falu n ye nani ku muoagu siigi ki kua o falu ni lan yoginu jakpeliga den sia o muoagu.
title: 4 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: Mi fantama n taa ya yoginu wan ye di samadili n ye nani o bile ko muli ñan mi kpama.
title: 4 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: U mu tuo ki gbeni wan yini samadili,
title: 4 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: wan jaligi ki ña u falu ki ye di jakpaliga n kua ku muoagu.
title: 4 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: O den kua ki wuoni ku muoagu samadili den sia ki tanleni o ko kpe.
title: 4 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: Mi ñama leni mi biadima kuli pia i panpani.
title: 4 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: Lanwani yua kuli n bua ki tieni mi hama.
title: 4 TELELE JAKPELIGA LENI

text: 5 TELELE LAAMO LENI JAKPELIGA.
title: 5 TELELE LAAMO LENI

text: Laamo leni jakpeliga den yen u dogu ni.
title: 5 TELELE LAAMO LENI

text: Laamo den yedi jakpeliga ba tieni i kuani,
title: 5 TELELE LAAMO LENI

text: jakpeliga den tuo.
title: 5 TELELE LAAMO LENI

text: Laamo den cili o pedi.
title: 5 TELELE LAAMO LENI

text: Laamo ya yugi ki ca o kuanu jakpeliga n ya cuoni ki wua hali ki ban tieni u sanu laamo kuanu.
title: 5 TELELE LAAMO LENI

text: Laamo den ti bualo o ya kan pedi o ?
title: 5 TELELE LAAMO LENI

text: wan ye di ke o ba pedi.
title: 5 TELELE LAAMO LENI

text: Laamo n den gbeni o kuanu ya yoginu ki taga n cili.
title: 5 TELELE LAAMO LENI

text: Jakpeliga n yedi o bado ke Laamo fie o kuanu.
title: 5 TELELE LAAMO LENI

text: o bado den yedi wan ban yii ne o na.
title: 5 TELELE LAAMO LENI

text: Laamo den pundi ki yedi ke o ya kuanu.
title: 5 TELELE LAAMO LENI

text: o bado den yedi ke yua kuli n teni o malima.
title: 5 TELELE LAAMO LENI

text: Jakpeliga den yedi ke o pia u sanu.
title: 5 TELELE LAAMO LENI

text: o bado n buali Laamo mo ya sanu.
title: 5 TELELE LAAMO LENI

text: wan yedi ke o na pia.
title: 5 TELELE LAAMO LENI

text: O bado n yedi ke jakpeliga n die u kuanu.
title: 5 TELELE LAAMO LENI

text: Laamo pali den bidi.
title: 5 TELELE LAAMO LENI

text: Lawani dana lie puoli Laamo n fa ki fii ki cua ki gbi u buogu o bado kpali kani ki pini o yuli ki gna o nuni bebe.
title: 5 TELELE LAAMO LENI

text: O bado n fa ki jie o den yeni mi ŋoagidamba a ma bi na den bandi lan tie ya lie.
title: 5 TELELE LAAMO LENI

text: O bado den teni ke bi yini jakpeliga.
title: 5 TELELE LAAMO LENI

text: Won nagini ki didi o na bandi ya la.
title: 5 TELELE LAAMO LENI

text: Wan yedi o bado n pia yanfuo buoli kuli.
title: 5 TELELE LAAMO LENI

text: N tieni mi yamfuoma ki gaa laamo kuanu,
title: 5 TELELE LAAMO LENI

text: ama line woni mi baani yaala.
title: 5 TELELE LAAMO LENI

text: Laamo den gnani ki sedi ki yedi o bado ŋaa la.
title: 5 TELELE LAAMO LENI

text: O bado den ga u kuanu ki teni Laamo.
title: 5 TELELE LAAMO LENI

text: Jambi ki pia diegu leni sala.
title: 5 TELELE LAAMO LENI

text: 6 TELELE KOKOLO LENI NAMU.
title: 6 TELELE KOKOLO LENI

text: Kokolo leni namuno n den ye,
title: 6 TELELE KOKOLO LENI

text: o kokolo n yedi namuno n ya dii i di n ni bon mune o namuno n yedi n ya kua ti didini li yen fa ke mi pia labali.
title: 6 TELELE KOKOLO LENI

text: Bi niba yen kpa ni.
title: 6 TELELE KOKOLO LENI

text: O den yedi o kokolo ba i tani ki nali a kan go ni i di muni o mo den guani o namuno a ya ye ti diedni ki gbadi ke n mua han bandi keli li ga yenda.
title: 6 TELELE KOKOLO LENI

text: Ya yianu n kuari n badi u ŋagu.
title: 6 TELELE KOKOLO LENI

text: 7 TELELE O BADO LENI TI MUOAYANDI.
title: 7 TELELE O BADO LENI TI

text: O bado n den pia o bisalo ki bua pa o jaa.
title: 7 TELELE O BADO LENI TI

text: O den bili li bali mama ke yuan fidi,
title: 7 TELELE O BADO LENI TI

text: ki lugdi li muoabali ke li cii ki sedi o diegnu o ba tene o o pua.
title: 7 TELELE O BADO LENI TI

text: Ti fuayandi den gedi li muoaceli ban den man gbeni bi den tani ki cua.
title: 7 TELELE O BADO LENI TI

text: Jakpeliga den bani ke kpado bani mi lugidima on den wuoni ki cua ki kali o moabali ni.
title: 7 TELELE O BADO LENI TI

text: O ba kuli na fidi ki lugidi ko moabali serdi li ya tie kpado.
title: 7 TELELE O BADO LENI TI

text: Wan den lugidi ke li sedi tugini jakpeliga den gnai ki sedi ki yedi ke o ya moabale.
title: 7 TELELE O BADO LENI TI

text: O bado den ta o pua ki teni o ke o ban kuni.
title: 7 TELELE O BADO LENI TI

text: O kpado n cua ki yedi ke o ya moabale o bado den guano ke o teni o pua jakpeliga.
title: 7 TELELE O BADO LENI TI

text: O kpado pali den fii ke o ban kali u munu.
title: 7 TELELE O BADO LENI TI

text: Lawani la mutuoli ya po n te ni ke o kpado pia a muyiga.
title: 7 TELELE O BADO LENI TI

text: 8 TELELE O BADO LENI TIE MUOAYANDI.
title: 8 TELELE O BADO LENI TIE

text: O bado den pia o deni tangu ke li bila.
title: 8 TELELE O BADO LENI TIE

text: O den yedi ke yua fiidi ki ŋa u tangu keli mua o ba teni o o pua.
title: 8 TELELE O BADO LENI TIE

text: O den puni sanu yua kuli n ban bogini ki cua.
title: 8 TELELE O BADO LENI TIE

text: Jakpeliga den kua li fuali ni ki ya mua ki go buali o yuli wan n ba tieni mama.
title: 8 TELELE O BADO LENI TIE

text: O den la i nuani ke bi buali o wan mua yali ya po.
title: 8 TELELE O BADO LENI TIE

text: O den ta li pakili ki togidi ba.
title: 8 TELELE O BADO LENI TIE

text: Bi den puni o li papali a ma bi den mia jakpeliga i dii.
title: 8 TELELE O BADO LENI TIE

text: O den ba i dii ki guani ki dinba.
title: 8 TELELE O BADO LENI TIE

text: Bi den yedi o ke wan ba li bagli ki tieni ba lieni ki ta laa u tulu.
title: 8 TELELE O BADO LENI TIE

text: Lawani o ya ban doni ku tangu po bi ba ya mua o badu bado ya tama ke u tangu n mua o ba teni o o pua.
title: 8 TELELE O BADO LENI TIE

text: Li daali pundi ti muoayandi kuli den tani o bado deni bi den cili ki do,
title: 8 TELELE O BADO LENI TIE

text: a ma o ba kuli na den fidi,
title: 8 TELELE O BADO LENI TIE

text: jakpeliga den doni ki juodi.
title: 8 TELELE O BADO LENI TIE

text: Lawani wan doni ki cii i nuani den cili i mue.
title: 8 TELELE O BADO LENI TIE

text: Ŋaa cuo cuo ŋaa ta ci ŋa tan calu ŋa ta cie,
title: 8 TELELE O BADO LENI TIE

text: ja janjanbidi ŋa ta ci.
title: 8 TELELE O BADO LENI TIE

text: O bado pali den mangi ke o ta jakpeliga pua ki teni o.
title: 8 TELELE O BADO LENI TIE

text: Yua lingi leni mi yanfuoma kuli ba baa.
title: 8 TELELE O BADO LENI TIE

text: 9 TELELE O KABO LENI LI KUNKULI.
title: 9 TELELE O KABO LENI LI

text: Bani den ta ki ye kan yendu.
title: 9 TELELE O KABO LENI LI

text: Daali kuli o kabo ba bigi ki jee li kunkuli a ma o yen gbali.
title: 9 TELELE O KABO LENI LI

text: Lawani o yen ña nipo ki ya puo a kpajela leni i nuani leni a kobila.
title: 9 TELELE O KABO LENI LI

text: Daali den ti kaali ko ñani ki na ba li ba kuli o den guani ki cili kunkuli leni u juogu ke wan wano ban di o mama.
title: 9 TELELE O KABO LENI LI

text: Kunkuli den ti juodi ki wani o.
title: 9 TELELE O KABO LENI LI

text: O den yedi o bi di n ni n muli po yo.
title: 9 TELELE O KABO LENI LI

text: O kabo den yugi ki jaagini o po ki cili o jiema.
title: 9 TELELE O KABO LENI LI

text: O den dini o juoli ki wadi o tana ki ban juodi o nuadi.
title: 9 TELELE O KABO LENI LI

text: La daali n tie kabo n bandi ban di kunkuli mama.
title: 9 TELELE O KABO LENI LI

text: Ñan da teni a yubali n bandi a ŋasiili.
title: 9 TELELE O KABO LENI LI

text: 10 TELELE DAMLI BI TAA.
title: 10 TELELE DAMLI BI TAA

text: Li kunkuli,
title: 10 TELELE DAMLI BI TAA

text: jakpeliga,
title: 10 TELELE DAMLI BI TAA

text: leni kpano.
title: 10 TELELE DAMLI BI TAA

text: Bani n den cili ye kan yendo.
title: 10 TELELE DAMLI BI TAA

text: Kpano den ŋani o bobili ku diguni ki ya ca ki sagidi a ma i bilsi den kali ke o ba li bobili n ni la yoginu li den tie pamanli kunkuli po ke o den cili ki ca guandi li bobili a ama o mo ko den ti ba li bobili n ni.
title: 10 TELELE DAMLI BI TAA

text: Li den cili ki pu leni n o haali ki ban bee.
title: 10 TELELE DAMLI BI TAA

text: Jakpeliga den cua ki lagi li bobili po,
title: 10 TELELE DAMLI BI TAA

text: ki sua ke li bena o den ta li bobili ki ban pa o namuno kelima o na bua nangu.
title: 10 TELELE DAMLI BI TAA

text: O mo ya pali den mangi ke o o cili i yani :
title: 10 TELELE DAMLI BI TAA

text: kpano leni kunkuli ŋani bi lieba,
title: 10 TELELE DAMLI BI TAA

text: kpano leni kunkuli ŋmani bi lieba.
title: 10 TELELE DAMLI BI TAA

text: O den yedi ke o kan jee sii n wani naani.
title: 10 TELELE DAMLI BI TAA

text: O den guadi yene ki ban lagi kina kan ŋmani muagu po,
title: 10 TELELE DAMLI BI TAA

text: o den jie ki ta o jiema ki teni o yangbanlo ka ba dini liba kuli.
title: 10 TELELE DAMLI BI TAA

text: A ya jagi tibu po han da laa o diamo.
title: 10 TELELE DAMLI BI TAA

text: A ma mi jiema tie bado.
title: 10 TELELE DAMLI BI TAA

text: 11 O KPAAKPAALO LENI O ŊMAAMO.
title: 11 O KPAAKPAALO LENI O

text: O kpaakpaalo den pia o kuanu ke li bali li juali po,
title: 11 O KPAAKPAALO LENI O

text: o ŋmaamo mu ko den ye la juali ki nan kpendi ki bi o kpaalo po.
title: 11 O KPAAKPAALO LENI O

text: O kpaalo de ta a jaaga o na fidi ki cuo o ŋmaamo.
title: 11 O KPAAKPAALO LENI O

text: O den li kpendi ki bidi o po.
title: 11 O KPAAKPAALO LENI O

text: O kpaalo den tieni a hania ki tani o jiema.
title: 11 O KPAAKPAALO LENI O

text: Wan den soani la tuonli ki gbeni o den ŋani a tina ki kuodi ki jieni li lenli ni ki ta ki sieni ki bali li juali yen kani.
title: 11 O KPAAKPAALO LENI O

text: O ŋmaamo den cua ki diidi ki sua ke tina n ye lieni.
title: 11 O KPAAKPAALO LENI O

text: O sua ke o kpaalo den cibi li lenli yeni wamu.
title: 11 O KPAAKPAALO LENI O

text: O den tuni ki ba yidi a tina.
title: 11 O KPAAKPAALO LENI O

text: Wan yidi o nu n yie ke li kan ŋa.
title: 11 O KPAAKPAALO LENI O

text: Wan yedi ke o yua li lenli ki gbali.
title: 11 O KPAAKPAALO LENI O

text: Lani ya po o kpaalo den cua ki pua kpa o.
title: 11 O KPAAKPAALO LENI O

text: Ŋambidu lan wagi mami kuli li daali ye.
title: 11 O KPAAKPAALO LENI O

text: 12 O BUALO LENI O NAMUNO.
title: 12 O BUALO LENI O

text: O bualo n den pia o natonli ki yedi yua bua kuli n ga ki ŋani binli po o mo ŋani o.
title: 12 O BUALO LENI O

text: Bi nubi kuli den yie a ma o namuno den tuo bi den ga ki ban ŋani li natonli.
title: 12 O BUALO LENI O

text: Li binli n lebidi,
title: 12 O BUALO LENI O

text: bualo den cua ki yedi ke o bua ki ga o panli.
title: 12 O BUALO LENI O

text: O namuno den yedi ke wan kuni ki guani sala.
title: 12 O BUALO LENI O

text: O den fa ki cua,
title: 12 O BUALO LENI O

text: o namuno den ban koa i niadi boni yia ki cua ba fundi ki ŋani.
title: 12 O BUALO LENI O

text: O den tien bu nunfanbu ki yedi ke o bi cuani niadi piig ke o nilo suni o niadi bu.
title: 12 O BUALO LENI O

text: A ma ke o ba bandi yua.
title: 12 O BUALO LENI O

text: O den kua ki ŋani leni ki juga.
title: 12 O BUALO LENI O

text: Ki ye ke yua ki suni ki jugi n da kodi o.
title: 12 O BUALO LENI O

text: O den cili ki bigi o pua wan cua o den lebidi nani ya po ki mani a ma la den kodo.
title: 12 O BUALO LENI O

text: o den bigi o bila kuli o ba kuli ki kpe.
title: 12 O BUALO LENI O

text: O bualo den yedi ke o moko na suni,
title: 12 O BUALO LENI O

text: ki gedi ki duani o namuno n bigi ;
title: 12 O BUALO LENI O

text: o mo den lebidi ki juga ki guani nani n mani ki ñi bualo nialu ŋmami ki kodo,
title: 12 O BUALO LENI O

text: wan fegi o juoli ke o ya ba poua o wan lia.
title: 12 O BUALO LENI O

text: Li bundi ke a ya jie ya li n ba jengna a mo ka ba gnan ba je ya la.
title: 12 O BUALO LENI O

text: 13 O BADO LENI TI FUAYANDI.
title: 13 O BADO LENI TI

text: O bado n de pia o bisalo ke o ŋani boncianla.
title: 13 O BADO LENI TI

text: Yua kuli den bua o.
title: 13 O BADO LENI TI

text: O mo den yedi n bisalo n baku ni yua n no yo.
title: 13 O BADO LENI TI

text: Yua fidi ki tuodi li ñibobitonli u mu po ke li pu,
title: 13 O BADO LENI TI

text: ki ñudi yema n biga ba kuni wane.
title: 13 O BADO LENI TI

text: Wan ba teni o bisalo ya daali,
title: 13 O BADO LENI TI

text: o den kpani ke bi jawaaba kuli tani.
title: 13 O BADO LENI TI

text: O den teni ke bi tuani li bobili yeni.
title: 13 O BADO LENI TI

text: Bi gbaman damba den cua liiga,
title: 13 O BADO LENI TI

text: o luomo n den cili.
title: 13 O BADO LENI TI

text: Mi ñima n sia o.
title: 13 O BADO LENI TI

text: Wan gbali o yangbanlo o namuno o muoanua leni ti yandi kuli den gedi ki gbali ki ban sieni jakpeliga.
title: 13 O BADO LENI TI

text: Wani n cua wan tuoadi li bobili ki ya wangi yaba n se li kani ki tuoa a nua ka ya bobili yeni jie ñiton n ma leni o ba gani ki cemini li sua ke li bobili ñima suanga wan yadi ki gnudi ki gedi ki ta o pua.
title: 13 O BADO LENI TI

text: O yafuodano n pia saa.
title: 13 O BADO LENI TI
